x: Popplewell was our first man in third place. George Chantler, A.
Whenman and Booker of Dartford came home together in the lead followed by Len Herbert and then came three Surrey Beagles. Alan Bishop was 13th, Arthur Bruce 16th, A.

Arthur Bruce and Len Bishop are two others now out of the junior stage who could be of use to our senior teams if they really give their minds to it and it is to the younger members of the Club that we must look for support if we are to regain our lost honours next season. The handicap was won by Len Bishop, with A.

Ches Walker was our last runner and although Peter Pirie gained 20 secs. on him, he was never in any danger of being caught, and finished a comfortable winner. We also had a “ B ” team competing and Eric and Alan Bishop both ran well, as did A.
The result was in doubt until our last scoring man, Arthur Saville, had finished, but he made up a few places on the last lap, and so we maintained our so far unbeaten record this season.
Our positions were: 1, Bedford; 4, Adams, L.; 5, Brickwood; 8, Brown, E. B.; 9, Bishop, L.; 10, Tooby; 12, Bishop, E.; 13, Davies, S.; and Alan Bishop and A.
Cornish (11), with Ian Forrester (8) second, and Gordon Lowers (5) third. The one mile handicap saw Mick Porter (130) run a good race to catch Tom Morrell (200) and A.
